speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
text: I should add that Keppel Corporation is a public-listed company and is accountable to its shareholders.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
text: The boards and management of Keppel Corporation and its subsidiaries, including Keppel Offshore and Marine Ltd (KOM), are responsible for the proper conduct of their businesses.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
text: It is incumbent upon them to run their businesses honestly and competently.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Law)
text: This would include detecting, reporting and preventing corrupt behaviour.
